summary.text: Adam Austill, an independent from Covington, Tennessee, and a doctoral candidate at the University of Memphis, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Tennessee's 8th District to David Kustoff.
His campaign messages focused on limiting the influence of money in Congress, accountability, and limits on artificial intelligence.

paragraphs.text: Austill graduated from Covington High School and describes himself as a long-time Covington resident with deep family ties to West Tennessee. He lives there with his wife and two youngest children.
His doctoral studies are in American literature, and he works providing ABA therapy for children with autism.
He received 0.4% of the vote to David Kustoff's 51.6%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
